messages.subject: 4PL model for dose-response
parts:
Hello - I am brand-new to STAN, and relatively new to Bayesian modeling (limited experience with linear regression in RJAGS). I am trying to fit a 4-parameter logistic model to some dose-response data, using RSTAN, and get the following error
 
Error in function stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Location parameter[0]  is -1.#IND:0, but must be finite!
 
 
I then get a message that says no samping took place. I also ran in debug mode, but didn't really get a more informative message. R Script and dataset attached.
 
As a Bayesian rookie, I suspect there is an issue with specifiying the model or conditioning the data, but can't really tell. I'm going to go try and fit the model in RJAGS to see if it's model/data issue; in the meantime, any advice or troubleshooting suggestions for STAN would be appreciated!

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] 4PL model for dose-response
parts:
There is a bug in RStan, which stops initialization parameters when such error happens.  It is supposed to try more times. 

But for your model, if I manually specify the initial values for the parameters, for example, 

a = 0
b = -1.7  
c = 0.6
d = 1.6e6
sigma = 4

Stan still cannot sample for this model (but it won't have the error you had).  I would suggest taking a good look of the data and see if the model make sense. 

--
Jiqiang
